title: Stone Falling into Lake
place: clear, shallow lake edge with autumn reflections (location not given)
people: hands only (one bare hand/fingertips flashes at the top centre for about 0.3 s around 2.1-2.4 s; no face)
notes: Vertical 1080x1920, looking down into clear water; golden autumn trees reflected in the top half. Slow motion. 0-2 s: still water. 2.1-2.4 s: a hand at the top (x~0.45, y~0.1) lets go of a stone, which falls through the frame (x~0.45, y 0.2-0.55). 2.7-4.0 s: big crater/crown: a cup-shaped water wall rises around the stone (x~0.4, y~0.2-0.4). 4.0-6.5 s: a tall central jet (Worthington jet) shoots up from the crater and falls back. 6.5-9 s: ring waves spread across the frame; 9-13 s: wide ripples (top-down view). Subject x~0.42, y~0.30. Shot A: 1.6-4.2 s (drop, crater). Shot B: 3.9-6.6 s (jet column). If the hand must not show, start shot A at 2.45 s.
